title: CutCraft
description: A Mod adds a new knifes to the game with special features
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bd38c1f186b1467afaaab725225d3860f5857af.webp)
- ## New Items:
  - Wooden Knife
  - Stone Knife
  - Iron Knife
  - Golden Knife
  - Diamond Knife
  - Netherite Knife

- ## New Foods:
  - Player Meat
  - Cooked Player Meat

- ## Features:
  - Let you damage yourself by clicking (Shift+ Right Click) key on any block
  - Drops a Player Meat when damage any player with any type of knife
  - Can Cook the Player Meat with any cook way in Minecraft
  - After eating a player meat with a chance the adds a bone to your inventory

> Report a bug in [https://discord.gg/creativty-studio](https://discord.gg/NyhU8Et4gW) and we will reply as soon we can
